footer.tagline: The B2B trading platform that brings buyers and suppliers together in one account.

audience.label: Which side are you on?
audience.supplierHint: I'm looking for requests to quote on

home.supplierTitle: Which request will you quote on?
home.supplierLead: Open requests from verified buyers, with sealed bids no competitor can see. Quoting is free with an account.
home.supplierCtaText: To quote and see the buyer,
home.buyerTitle: What product are you looking for?
home.buyerLead: Browse verified suppliers' showcases with price and minimum order details.
home.buyerCtaText: Can't find the product you need?
home.newestLead: The latest products suppliers added to their showcases.
home.demandsTitle: What buyers are looking for right now
home.demandsLead: Line items, quantities, scope and time left are public. Buyer name, specifications and documents are for members only, under the sealed-bid rule.
home.demandsEmpty: After you sign up, requests are matched to your categories in your panel.
home.showcaseTitle: Is your product in the showcase?
home.showcaseLead: Publish your products with price and minimum order details so buyers can find you and send inquiries. The showcase is open on the free plan too.
home.seoParagraph: Rothern is a B2B marketplace that lists products from manufacturers, distributors and service providers in Turkey with price and minimum order details, and matches buying requests with sealed-bid quotes. Product and company profiles are public; a free account is needed to quote, request information and see buyer details.
home.metaTitle: B2B marketplace: products, suppliers and buying requests
home.metaDescription: Browse verified suppliers' products with price and MOQ, talk to companies, and send sealed-bid quotes on buying requests. Buyer and seller in one account. Signing up is free.
home.metaAbsoluteTitle: Rothern — B2B marketplace: products, suppliers and buying requests
home.comingSoonDescription: Rothern is currently in development. We'll be with you very soon.

comingSoon.title: We'll be with you very soon
comingSoon.body: Rothern is the B2B trading platform that brings buyers and suppliers together in one account. We're finishing the final preparations and will be here shortly.

rfq.point2: Quotes never see each other: sealed bids
rfq.point3: Comparison table, award on one screen
rfq.title: Post one request, receive several sealed-bid quotes

trustBand.title: From request to quote, from quote to order
trustBand.lead: Browsing is free. Quoting and company details need a free account; no commission is charged.
trustBand.step1Title: Sign up and introduce your company
trustBand.step1Body: One account makes you both a buyer and a seller. Pick your activity and categories; matching requests come to you.
trustBand.step2Body: Only the request owner sees your quote. Competing suppliers see neither your price, nor your identity, nor how many quotes came in.
trustBand.step3Body: The award decision creates the order automatically; you follow delivery and payment steps from the same panel.

trustStrip.label: Trust signals
trustStrip.verifiedBody: Identity verified with tax registration and trade registry documents.
trustStrip.sealedBody: Only the request owner sees your quote; competitors never do.
trustStrip.noFeeBody: The platform takes no share of the transaction value.
trustStrip.kvkkBody: Your data is processed in line with Turkish data protection law.

twoCards.sellTitle: List your company, put your products in the showcase
twoCards.buyBody: Get open requests matching your category by email; submit your sealed-bid quote from the panel and let the buyer compare.

flow.label: Three steps for buyers
flow.step1Body: Find the product, company or category. Price and minimum order are shown on the card.
flow.step2Body: Found it? Send the company an inquiry. Didn't? Post a request and let suppliers matching your category quote.
flow.step3Body: Bidders never see each other. Compare in one table and award; the order is created automatically.
